items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in – we was on a gig in Las Vegas where Barbra Streisand was in the big room and Sass was in the lounge, in the same hotel.

ctx.x: Or Barbra Streisand and Sarah Vaughan.
Yeah. I was in – we was on a gig in Las Vegas where Barbra Streisand was in the big room and Sass was in the lounge, in the same hotel.
